title: Activation link is cryptographically secure and unique
gherkin:
Feature: Activation Link Security
  Scenario: Activation link is cryptographically secure and unique
    Given a new user registers with email "user@example.com"
    When the system sends an account activation email
    Then the activation link in the email should be cryptographically secure
    And each activation link should be unique for different registrations
    And the activation token should not be predictable or easily guessable
rationale: Ensures that activation links are generated using cryptographic methods to prevent token prediction attacks and guarantee uniqueness across registrations.
usedContextItems: System shall send account activation email with unique activation link after successful registration|Activation links must be cryptographically secure and time-limited
